clock_model.rtl_boundary: clk_i rising edge advances one complete normalized processor cycle when clock_enable_i is high
clock_model.historical_boundary: MC6800 uses non-overlapping phi1 and phi2 inputs; data transfer is active during phi2
clock_model.limitation: This normalized wrapper does not project subphases; use mc6800-four-subphase-integration-bus for documented digital phase ordering. Nanosecond widths, separation, setup, and hold timing are outside synthesizable digital scope

signals.name: clk_i
signals.fact: one rising edge advances one complete normalized processor cycle; this is not either historical phase pin

signals.name: clock_enable_i
signals.fact: active high normalized-cycle enable; low preserves core architectural state

signals.name: nmi_n_i
signals.fact: active-low non-maskable interrupt whose falling edge is retained

signals.name: address_o
signals.fact: 16-bit address value; use address_oe_o for the documented three-state condition

signals.name: address_oe_o
signals.fact: disabled while BA is active or TSC is asserted

signals.name: data_o
signals.fact: processor write data; use data_oe_o for bus drive

signals.name: data_oe_o
signals.fact: enabled only for a valid write while DBE is high and the MPU owns the bus

signals.name: read_not_write_o
signals.fact: one for read and zero for write; use read_not_write_oe_o for three-state

signals.name: read_not_write_oe_o
signals.fact: disabled while BA is active or TSC is asserted

signals.name: vma_o
signals.fact: active high only for valid memory cycles while the MPU owns the bus; forced low by reset, HALT/WAIT bus release, or TSC

signals.name: ba_o
signals.fact: active high after HALT completes the current instruction or while WAI awaits an interrupt; forced low by reset and TSC

signals.name: halt_n_i
signals.fact: active low; execution stops at the next completed instruction and resumes when high

signals.name: tsc_i
signals.fact: active high; stalls the normalized core, removes address and R/W drive, and forces VMA and BA low

signals.name: dbe_i
signals.fact: active high data-bus output enable; normally follows phi2 in a physical system

halt_interrupt_behavior: IRQ low levels and NMI falling edges observed while halted, including the HALT-entry boundary, are retained until the core acknowledges the matching interrupt class after HALT release
